title: buddleja dysophylla
intro: Buddleja dysophylla, commonly known as Butterfly Bush, is a species of flowering plant in the family Scrophulariaceae. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Buddleja dysophylla are attributed to its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce stress and anxiety, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, are responsible for its medicinal properties and may help to protect against oxidative stress and inflammation.
